name: mirofish
description: Stable MiroFish research fork with multi-model backtesting and observability

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run --frozen --python 3.11 python run.py
scripts.check:runtime: npm run smoke-test && npm run run-example && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run hygiene && npm run smoke-test && npm run run-example && npm test && npm run build
scripts.docker-up:openrouter-smoke: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.openrouter-smoke.yml --profile graphiti up --build --wait
scripts.docker-up:deepinfra-smoke: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.deepinfra-smoke.yml --profile graphiti up --build --wait
scripts.docker-test: docker compose exec -T mirofish npm run check:runtime
scripts.docker-down:openrouter-smoke: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.openrouter-smoke.yml --profile graphiti down --remove-orphans
scripts.docker-down:deepinfra-smoke: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.deepinfra-smoke.yml --profile graphiti down --remove-orphans
